description: This file contains the implementation of the LocalReminderService class within the Orleans project, responsible for managing local reminders, registering, updating, unregistering, and firing reminders in a distributed environment.

classes.name: LocalReminderService
classes.description: Implements the reminder service responsible for managing reminders on a single silo, handling registration, unregistration, and delivery of reminders.

classes.name: LocalReminderData
classes.description: Represents a locally managed reminder, handling timer setup, firing, and stopping of reminder ticks.

classes.name: ReminderIdentity
classes.description: A struct used as a unique identifier for reminders within the local reminder service, based on GrainId and reminder name.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers a new reminder or updates an existing one in the global reminder table, then sets up local timers.

methods.name: UnregisterReminder
methods.description: Removes a reminder both locally and from the global reminder table.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a reminder by GrainId and reminder name from the global reminder table.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders associated with a specific GrainId.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the local reminder service, disposing timers and stopping reminders.

methods.name: StartInBackground
methods.description: Begins the background process that reads and refreshes reminders periodically.

methods.name: ReadAndUpdateReminders
methods.description: Reads reminders from the global table and updates local state accordingly.

methods.name: ReadTableAndStartTimers
methods.description: Reads reminders from a specific range in the reminder table and initiates local timers for new/updated reminders.

methods.name: StartAndAddTimer
methods.description: Creates and starts a local timer for a given reminder entry, replacing existing if necessary.

methods.name: TryStopPreviousTimer
methods.description: Stops the existing local timer for a reminder if it exists.

methods.name: DoResponsibilitySanityCheck
methods.description: Ensures that the reminder action is performed only if within the responsible range and the service is active.
